name: Parent Notification of Direct Involvement in Weapons Incident
description: Immediate notice to parents of students directly involved as victim or suspect, including whether police have been or may be notified; attempts are documented.
recipient: Parents/guardians of student victims or suspects
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall notify the parent/guardian of any student directly involved in an incident involving weapons as a victim or suspect immediately, as soon as practicable. The Superintendent or designee shall inform the parent/guardian whether or not the law enforcement agency that has jurisdiction over the school property has been or may be notified of the incident.
